name: Texture-Mapped Volume Rendering with CPU Shading
definition: A volume rendering method for regular grids that uses 3D texture mapping hardware to resample density and pre-computed gradients, then transfers samples to main memory for CPU-based Phong shading and compositing. It solves the problem of view-dependent shading in texture-mapped rendering without requiring expensive post-texturing LUTs or reloading textures for every frame.
